svg.text: decline to 10% by the last point
Trend test across all points. Each drift-aware value is the mean realised rate of 20 thresholds, each set by SPOT from its own neutral replicates
(2,000 by default; c: up to 200,000) and tested on 60,000 (c: up to 1,000,000) independent neutral replicates. Red: naive test.
Reference design: haplodiploid, 1935/1955/1975/2025, 20/20/20/40 females, 10×/15× depth, p₀ = 0.1. a: Ne varied in each inheritance system. b: one factor changed at a time.
